Name: Genshin Impact Plushies - Liyue
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
They are finally here! After almost a one month break [size=1](university isn't kind to me...)[/size], the Liyue characters have joined the marketable plushies gang!
[line]
[b][i][color=#f9cb9c][size=3]Features[/size][/color][/i][/b]
🪨 All [b]21 playable characters from Liyue [/b][size=1](as of Luna I)[/size], added as [b]new furniture[/b] placeable both indoors and outdoors
📜 [b]Characters included, in order of release:[/b] Zhongli, Keqing, Qiqi, Xiangling, Xingqiu, Chongyun, Ningguang, Beidou, Xinyan, Ganyu, Xiao, Hu Tao, Yanfei, Yun Jin, Shenhe, Yelan, Yaoyao, Baizhu, Xianyun, Gaming and Lan Yan
🪨 Easily find them in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39884]Genshin Plushies Catalogue[/url]﻿!
📜 If you don't have my catalogue, they'll be in the [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b] [size=1](search for 'Genshin' or 'Liyue' if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url])[/size]
🪨 Consolation for when you want a character but the gacha isn't kind to you - at least you can have them in a different game!
📜 [b]i18n compatible![/b] Includes English and Spanish as of 1.0.0
[line]
[b][i][color=#f9cb9c][size=3]Future Plans[/size][/color][/i][/b]
🪨 This will be updated for as long as I'm still into both Stardew and Genshin [size=1](aka a very, [i]very[/i] long time, because I've invested way too much on both to let go)[/size], so [b]new characters will be added as they're released![/b]
📜 [b]Continuing the series![/b]
   ✧ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38334]Mondstadt[/url]
   ✧ ﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39263]Liyue[/url] - you're here!
   ﻿✧ Inazuma
   ✧ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46223]Sumeru[/url]
   ✧ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38492]Fontaine[/url]
   ✧ ﻿Natlan
   ﻿✧ Nod-Krai
   ✧ Other Factions [size=1](Harbingers, Mages and the Twins will be here - including Childe!)[/size]
   ✧ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39884]Paimon Catalogue[/url]
[line]
Hi, it's your recurrent [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35360]Botany of Teyvat[/url] advertisement here - GO GET [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35360]BOTANY OF TEYVAT[/url]. Give Xiao his sea of Qingxins! Put Zhongli next to the beautiful Glaze Lilies so he can be extra sad about Guizhong! Grow Chenyu Adeptea! Admire [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/oclarina]Oclarina[/url]'s pretty art and amazing mod! And while you're at it get [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38335]MMMMoT[/url] as well and find some Cor Lapis, Bamboo Shoots, and even [i]more[/i] pretty forageables!
[size=1]And if you want/use Botany of Teyvat but also use Vanilla Tweaks and want them to match, I might have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39250]just the thing[/url] for you...[/size]

[size=2]Also hi Oclarina, hope you like these <3[/size]
[line]
[color=#fce5cd][size=2]For the Liyue fun fact: I actually own a Hu Tao cosplay! Have been wearing it to cons for 4 years now hehe
She's my pretty lady, she deserves everything <3 (She's also the first and only skin I've bought - but it's so pretty, I [i]needed[/i] to get it!)[/size][/color]
